page.overview:
What is C-Moon Ultimate Requiem?

Dio Brando (temporarily)|type=Evolved Stands Long Ranged Stands Natural Humanoid Stands|mangadebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 16: Beyond II

Category:Stands Category:Ultimate Stands

faces and six arms. The arrow was a part of it now, and the Stand's new power emerged.|Jorge describes Whitesnake Ultimate evolving into an even stronger power}} C-Moon Ultimate Requiem (C-Moon アルティメットレクイエム C - Moon arutimettorekuiemu) is the evolved Stand of Whitesnake Ultimate after being stabbed by the Arrow; which is featured in the light novel, JORGE JOESTAR. It is used by Kars and temporarily Dio, which later evolves into Made in Heaven Ultimate Requiem.

It is Kars' version of Enrico Pucci's, C-Moon. As it is stabbed, Kars is given a Wound, and which it evolves into C-Moon Ultimate Requiem.
